scope: Exact full mixed row, paired-end and bolt cancellations, ordinary fixed-seed graph/phase composite domain and complete affine input conversion. Numerical composite norm and strong feasibility remain unresolved.
ordinary_post_development_review: Before final acceptance, reviewed the full physical first-row congruence and common Ward reduction against the exact local generator. Both order-three/four cancellations and all outer valuations use the complete sum after the vacuum identity. Reviewed the adjoint primitives in physical z^-4 dz and their combined Q divisibility at the actual simple bolt: individual logarithms cannot be bounded separately. The combined integral removes them before division. The full physical rho_a factor is retained. Inverse York self-adjointness and absence of resonant leading log follow from the original auxiliary Dirichlet realization. The coupled normal argument uses weighted Sobolev source expansions and continuous Mellin residues, not analyticity of form inputs. Two applications give the original graph/phase domain; numerical constants and physical areal C5 maps remain unknown. The affine normalization uses the full source transform and the coupled Hessian norm; no independent feedback input is assigned that value. Retained one structural-comparison failure and both intermediate successful source snapshots, then replayed the final proof before unchanged acceptance. No numerical strong inverse or signed field application occurred.
